_comment: MORPH: THE BEYOND-HORIZON PUMP POLICY (Morph INT-2d, 2026-11-12; morph.md step 8). DEPTH 0 -- the d0 runner,
i.e. the same greedy (TurnSolver::SolveUncached) the playout runs past the search horizon.
Turn 3: a face-down Blistering Firecat (a 2/2 that can attack) and a Spellskite (0/4, FIRST on the
battlefield), three untapped lands (Forest, Forest, Mountain), Might of Old Krosa + Berserk + Temur Battle Rage
in hand, Mountains on top. Turn 3's best pump line is Might (main phase: +4) + Berserk on the Firecat = 12 < 20,
so the greedy HOLDS the tricks and swings for 2 (18). Turn 4 draws a Mountain: Might (6) -> Berserk (12) ->
Temur Battle Rage (double strike: 24) on the FIRECAT = lethal.
DISCRIMINATING, both halves of GreedyTrickStackCredit / GreedyHeldTrick:
* the old greedy cast every affordable trick on turn 3 (12 damage, Berserk then destroys the Firecat at end
step) and has no attacker left -- unwon;
* the old greedy aimed every trick at the FIRST creature (equal evals, smallest-mask tie): Spellskite, whose
0 power doubles to 0. Only a recipient-aware projection picks the Firecat for the turn-4 kill.
